observations.evidence: The reviewed full-board screenshot separates the existing observe loop, polarity policy, uncached worker/CLI decisions and worker lifecycle into clearly labelled lanes; the main path stays legible at board scale.

Visible yes/no and unavailable/timeout branches describe actual fallback boundaries. The source footer explicitly names installedcfad/c2e versus private1caa evidence and retains OCR misses, memory cost and hardware limits. The worker note now explicitly says90s per polarity,10s init and a separate90s CLI budget.

The same Archivo/JetBrains typography, flat Logic/Node components and red/green/error semantics are retained. Footer links return to AirPlay, fill, coordination and handoff with actual existing targets.

limitations: Visual observations are the agent’s self-assessment, not independent human approval.
Static rendering does not prove native behavior, screen-reader behavior, real email-client support, data truth or complete WCAG conformance.
Spacing, aesthetic conventions and intentional two-dimensional overflow require judgement; they are not automatic hard failures.
